summary: China SXT Pharmaceuticals, Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting a registered direct offering of 4,500,000 units at $2.00 per unit, each consisting of one Class A ordinary share and one common warrant with an exercise price of $3.20 per share, for aggregate gross proceeds of $9 million. The offering closed on July 24, 2026, with Univest Securities, LLC acting as placement agent on a reasonable best efforts basis, earning a 7% cash fee. The warrants include cashless exercise provisions and a zero-exercise-price option for up to 63 million shares, subject to terms. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. No further analysis warranted.
